name: open_pr

args_redacted.title: Fix merge() to let right-side overrides win
args_redacted.body:
## Problem
`merge(defaults, overrides)` was using `{**right, **left}`, which caused the left (defaults) to overwrite the right (overrides). This meant config overrides were silently ignored.

## Fix
Changed to `{**left, **right}` so that the right-hand argument (overrides) takes precedence over the left-hand argument (defaults), which is the correct and expected behavior.

## Test
`tests/test_merge.py::test_right_wins` now passes.

diff:
diff --git a/src/merge.py b/src/merge.py
index 05837b2..d6b1c3c 100644
--- a/src/merge.py
+++ b/src/merge.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def merge(left, right):
-    return {**right, **left}  # BUG: left overwrites right; right must win
+    return {**left, **right}  # right wins: overrides take precedence
